title: Greg's 60 s rule beyond Engram calls: inventory and raise other operation-aborting limits under 60 s (Git captures and others)
outcome: Every operation-aborting or operation-resetting limit in TermAl outside the Engram call paths that w-18a1ae323de4 covers is at least 60 s with a 10 s non-aborting warning, or carries recorded evidence for Greg; no local exception is made.
acceptance: Every operation-aborting or resetting limit under 60 s in TermAl's non-Engram paths (Git source captures, process waits, HTTP or child-process deadlines and similar) is listed on this item with its value and caller.

Each listed limit is raised to at least 60 s with a 10 s warning that does not abort, longer limits are unchanged, and where the minimum is believed to cause a real problem the evidence is recorded on this item for Greg without introducing an exception. Escalation after an already-issued stop and retry cadence are out of scope.
Behavioural tests with scaled clocks (no real 60 s waits) cover a representative slow-but-under-60-s operation succeeding with one warning and one past the limit failing with the existing handling.
